name: BD Transaction History Forensic Investigation
description: Fundamental investigation of the BD transaction data pipeline from raw bronze SFTP files through deduplication, classification, FIFO reconstruction, and final positions cube / holdings lots. The FIFO reconstruction produces $1.98B in holdings lots vs BD's $1.59B silver AUA -- a $390M overshoot BEFORE any injection runs. Root cause suspected in deduplication logic (34% dedup rate on 2.79M rows), transaction type misclassification (corporate actions, transfers, passthroughs), or ghost positions from same-day multi-lot transactions being collapsed.
phase: P1 DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE (04-01). AE.003 done: RPS silver built (534 partitions, 2024-01-12 to 2026-02-27, OK=534). DS diagnostic (adhc_histry_005) ran on EC2. Results: injection needed $402M / 36,788 positions / 4,347 accounts. DIVZ post-injection $163.7M (target $150-160M, slightly above). Residual gap after injection +$772.9M. DS notified, proceeding to Phase 2 analysis.
blocking: None. DS proceeding to Phase 2 (interpret residual gap, determine next injection adjustments).
